tpl: Passive Effect: Drone +1 Active Effect: Can switch between the default state and the following state: ATK +{0}, releases Drones to lock and attack non-mobile enemies across the entire battlefield, searching for a new target if the enemy moves or is defeated

Drone +3, Attack Range expands, ATK +{0}, releases Drones to lock and attack random enemies; when Drones attack, they have a 10% chance to inflict Fear for 1s When the Drone's locked-on target is defeated, they will search for a new one; when the skill ends, they return to the Operator

Drone +2, ATK +{0}, releases special Drones that scatter across the entire battlefield and chase the closest enemy to them; upon reaching their target, inflicts Fear for {1}s, locks the target and attacks it; enemies around the Drones have {2} Movement Speed and take {3} ATK as Arts damage every second (does not stack); When the Drone's locked-on target is defeated, they will search for a new one; when the skill ends, they return to the Operator
